record.title: Evaluate complete ADC validation and select the next ambiguity
record.intent: Use the recovered graph to choose region-level validation or a hardware-returned hypothesis.
requirements: Distinguish static predictions, live bindings/software-state checks, completed synthetic stores and uncompleted accesses.
Treat mismatch as a conclusion requiring deliberate re-planning, not adaptive transcript growth.
Evaluate SPU as the already recovered eight-write region with four shadows and separate GetSampleMode(1) and GetSampleMode(15) selections; do not rediscover each write independently.
If a hardware-returned read, serial interface or DMA boundary intervenes, select its specific consuming behavior and uncertainty rather than widening the model by default.
acceptance: Select and justify a bounded successor or concrete blocker, with conclusions committed and pushed before the next experiment.
